Name: Eden, Priest Distributor
Summary: Eden served with Kore in the cities of the priests, giving portions to his brethren by courses, great and small, under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Eden served with Kore in the cities of the priests, giving portions to his brethren by courses, great and small, under Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: Kore, Son of Imnah; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Fair portions for every priest, great and small, came through faithful distributors.
